CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 10

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36

   C. 90

   A. 12

   C. 26
   D. 13

12. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4

   D. 10

13. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8

   C. 5
   D. 4

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 44

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 0

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 5

17. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)

   A. 156

   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

25. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
